name: Fluffy Pancakes
ingredients: Milk (same amount as water listed on the package)
instructions: Preheat a lightly greased skillet over medium heat.
Combine pancake mix, milk, eggs, and vanilla; stir until just blended (a few lumps are fine).
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook until golden.
notes: Add blueberries to the batter for a treat.

name: Weeknight Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef; 1 packet taco seasoning; tortillas; shredded lettuce; shredded cheese; salsa
instructions: Brown the meat in a skillet; Stir in seasoning and water per packet; Simmer 5 minutes; Serve in tortillas with toppings
